question: Which are the 5 countries that form part of the BRICS alliance?

options.text: Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa
Britain, Russia, India, China, South Korea

solution:
The correct answer is __**Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **BRICS** is a group of five major emerging economies: **Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa**. The name is an acronym formed from the initial letters of the member countries.
 
• BRICS was initially formed in **2006** as BRIC (Brazil, Russia, India, China), with South Africa joining the alliance in **2010** to form BRICS.
 
• The group represents a significant portion of the world's population, economy, and landmass, accounting for about **42% of the global population**, **25% of the global GDP**, and **30% of the global land area**.
 
• These countries are known for their fast-growing economies and significant influence on regional and global affairs. They aim to promote peace, security, development, and cooperation among themselves and globally.
